About

Understand Technology. See the Connections. Build Solutions.

I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.

With NAHX Technologies, I bring together my own technical services, development projects and future digital solutions under a personal brand.

My approach is pragmatic: understand the requirements, develop an appropriate solution and validate the results transparently.

I work directly and project by project, with the goal of translating technical complexity into practical outcomes.
